_comment: Sample data for the template_report example. Fictional client; not legal advice.

summary.text:
Consent capture and breach response need work before the next audit.
Retention and grievance handling are largely in place.

gaps.title: Consent is bundled with the terms of service
gaps.finding: The sign-up form asks for one acceptance covering the terms of service and all processing purposes.
actions: Separate consent from the terms of service.
Ask for consent per purpose, with a plain-language notice.
Record consent with a timestamp and the notice version shown.

gaps.title: No documented breach response procedure
gaps.finding: There is no procedure for notifying the Board and affected data principals of a breach.
actions: Write a breach response runbook with named owners.

gaps.title: Erasure requests are handled by email only
gaps.finding: Requests arrive in a shared inbox and are not tracked to completion.
actions: Track requests in a ticketing queue with a response deadline.

next_steps: Address G-01 and G-02 first.	A follow-up review is planned for January 2027.
